rationale: Both Parth and Balakumar work on robotics at leading hardware/AI companies with complementary expertise—Parth brings hands-on mechanical and hardware testing experience from Tesla's humanoid robot program, while Balakumar contributes research-level depth in motion planning, perception (LiDAR, force sensing), and ROS-based systems from NVIDIA. Their combined background spans the full stack from physical testing to algorithmic robotics, making them natural collaborators for discussing humanoid robot development challenges.
intro_message: Parth Behani, meet Balakumar Sundaralingam — you're both building expertise in humanoid robotics at Tesla and NVIDIA respectively, and your skills in hardware testing and perception/motion planning could spark useful conversation.
